A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner begs Chris to find a way to stop the execution.

Honey the spoodle leapt from a car doing 40 km/h to chase a cat. She survived, but how bad are her injuries? Owner Ilana's riddled with guilt for not strapping her in—and wait till you see Honey's reaction when she hears cats out the back.
Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour.

A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan's horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash, but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.
Chris is confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. A young girl's much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive tumour. But surgery on such a small patient is a challenge.

Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

Observe as Chris treats Pearl, a poodle that began bleeding internally at the groomer, while surgeons try to save Zoe, a cat that dove off a second-floor balcony. Meanwhile, the clinic gets a special gift from a grateful patient.

Join the team’s 24-hour vigil for Lucu, a pup that’s been bitten by a tick. Then check out Jonti, a cat with a gaping hole in his neck that’s scarily close to his jugular vein—all while Chris tangles with an evasive lame emu.
A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer? And will she ever be able to fly?

Chris fights to save one of the clinic’s favorite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now he is the victim of a hit run accident.

The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It's all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked it and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of his injuries.

Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us it's like a third testicle swinging in the wind. But when it comes to surgery it's no laughing matter for Chris.

Peaceful farmer Benjamin Martin is driven to lead the Colonial Militia during the American Revolution when a sadistic British officer murders his son.
A bitter instructor employs violent fighters in his quest for revenge against the karate student who humiliated him.

A suave bank robber attempts to pull off another heist while being hunted by the US marshal he once took hostage. Federal agent Karen Sisco falls for his charms while determined to put the notorious Jack Foley behind bars.

Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine whether human beings are to remain the apex predators.
When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.
A tycoon invites a group of scientists to trial his island amusement park, where genetically engineered dinosaurs roam. When a disgruntled employee turns off the power, chaos ensues.

Skilled operatives travel to an island research facility to secure life-saving DNA from dinosaurs. As the top-secret mission becomes more and more dangerous, they soon make a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.
A giant shark is feeding on the good people of Amity Island, and it's up to police chief Martin Brody to hunt down the finned fiend.

p.t: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
p.d: When an ancient emperor's tomb is discovered in the 1940s, Rick O'Connell and his wife become involved in a plot to restore the emperor to power.

On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.
On a camping trip, the all-American Henderson family run over the legendary Bigfoot. Taking him home to suburbia was a mistake though: he's loveable, but he's a seven-foot wrecking ball.

Searching for a safer habitat, the prehistoric Crood family discover an idyllic paradise. Unfortunately, they must also learn to live with the Bettermans, an advanced clan who are a few steps above the Croods on the evolutionary ladder.
After an aptitude test mix-up, Fred Flintstone is promoted. An evil executive, however, plots to use Fred in an embezzlement scheme.

When the Primm family move to New York City, their young son, Josh, struggles to adapt to his new school and new friends. All of that changes when he meets Lyle, a singing crocodile who loves baths, caviar, and great music.
A grouchy ogre and his jabbering donkey sidekick set out to rescue an imprisoned princess from a scheming lord.
Shrek faces his greatest challenge yet: the in-laws. Shrek and Princess Fiona return from their honeymoon to find an invitation to visit Fiona's parents, the King and Queen of Far, Far Away.
Shrek and friends set out to find Fiona's slacker cousin, Artie, and bring him back to rule the land of Far, Far Away.
Shrek makes a deal with an embittered Rumpelstiltskin that lands him in an alternate reality where he was never born, and faces a race against time to break the spell and rescue Fiona.
With 3 million young drivers using the country's roads, it's a round the clock challenge for the Traffic Cops to keep them in check.
A look at how Yorkshire Ambulance Service's Hazardous Area Response Team deals with trauma incidents.
The Interceptors come under attack from a gang of violent, armed robbers, and boys in 'Big Blue Van' respond to reports of bottles raining down on streets.
Thousands of people flock to Bondi during the height of coronavirus and social distancing; the state police minister arrives.
Judge Judy Sheindlin tackles real-life small claims cases with her no nonsense attitude.
Judge Judy Sheindlin tackles real-life small claims cases with her no nonsense attitude.

A woman sues her former roommate for various living expenses accrued from when he lived with her, with her claiming that her family wanted to help him get an education; a woman is sued by her boyfriend's daughter for rent and property return.
A woman sues her ex-boyfriend for the return of her German Shepherd, Bailey; he countersues for cell phone cancellation fees and pet expenses.
Every day, 20,000 passengers enter Canada through Vancouver Airport. Phoney tourists, drug toys, aggressive visitors and weapon-phones keep security on constant alert.
Tobacco is the most trafficked commodity in the world. Australian Border Force join with Victoria Police to bust an unsuspecting criminal syndicate bringing in millions of cigarettes illegally.
In New Zealand, the term 'Police Ten 7' means 'Police have arrived on the scene'. This unique fly-on-the-wall reality series brims with action as it follows urban cops on the beat.
Sergeants pull over a driver for failing to put on his headlights, but the driver takes a vow of silence on the advice of his passenger and refuses to say anything. A car runs a red light.
Flip the ignition and prepare for a brand-new episode of Caught On Dashcam. From nail-biting near misses to encounters with things that go bump in the night, we’ve got it all caught on camera!
Jim leads a raid on a suspected drug dealer, Dan and Gordy respond to a violent alleyway attack, and Jon goes on the hunt for a serial frugal driver.
A fleeing suspect tries every excuse to get out of going to jail. A driver asks deputies to hide the truth from his wife. A trespassing call becomes a neighbourhood-wide ordeal.

Rickey, an energetic and free-spirited young man with a Peter Pan complex, convinces his long-time friend Glenn to hit pause on his blissful domestic life and embark on an impromptu road trip across California.
Small-town private investigator Honey O'Donahue probes a series of strange deaths that are tied to a mysterious church.
An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.
Jesse Stone's relationship with his ex-wife is getting more and more difficult. To ensure that he does not fall back into his old drinking habits again, he tries to solve an old case.
A man and his sister discover something sinister in the skies above their California horse ranch, while the owner of a nearby theme park tries to profit from the mysterious, otherworldly phenomenon.
Two conspiracy-obsessed men kidnap the CEO of a major company when they become convinced that she's an alien who wants to destroy Earth.
A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbour is pitted against neighbour in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.
When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

A military-grade robotic weapon known as Amelia becomes increasingly self-aware and dangerous to the human race. Hoping to stop it, Gemma, an advocate for oversight of AI, decides to resurrect M3GAN, making it faster, stronger, and more lethal.

Skilled operatives travel to an island research facility to secure life-saving DNA from dinosaurs. As the top-secret mission becomes more and more dangerous, they soon make a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.
A man embarks on a journey across five continents and seven oceans in a desperate bid to overcome fear and trauma, and reclaim his life.

William Shakespeare and his wife, Agnes, celebrate the birth of their son, Hamnet. However, when tragedy strikes and Hamnet dies at a young age, it inspires Shakespeare to write his timeless masterpiece "Hamlet.".
Two young men during World War I set out to record the lives, voices and music of their American countrymen.
Kristin Harila risked everything to summit the world's 14 highest peaks at record speed. When her final ascent sparked backlash, her greatest triumph became a reckoning.
The true story of seasoned deep-sea divers who battle the raging elements to rescue a crewmate who's trapped hundreds of feet below the ocean's surface.
The Crawley family goes on a grand journey to the South of France to uncover the mystery of the dowager countess's newly inherited villa.
An ousted sports agent attempts to rebuild his career with the help of a loyal accountant and an egotistical athlete.
A young woman sends romantic texts to her deceased fiancé's number to get over the pain of his death. She soon forms a connection with the man to whom the number has been reassigned.

A struggling matchmaker is hired by a king to find his son a suitable wife in time for a national celebration. As the clock ticks toward the deadline, the matchmaker finds him the perfect wife, only to realise she's fallen in love with him.

At the end of the 19th century, a poor Irishman heads for the New World in the hope of becoming rich. He meets a wealthy and beautiful woman, and together they struggle before reaching their paradise in Oklahoma.

Lt. Callie Jackson returns home after a military tour to find her late grandfather's barbecue joint is struggling, but she has a run-in with a TV director who teaches her that sometimes it's best to look forward instead of looking back.

Young Maya pesters her dad to tell her why he's getting divorced, so he tells her the story of his (love) life. Has he missed out on his soulmate?

p.t: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
p.d: An advice columnist attempts to make a man dump her in 10 days, but he makes a bet with his boss that he will make her fall in love with him.
Facing a crossroads in her life, a divorcee travels to Italy, India and Bali on a quest to change her life and find true happiness.
In 1943, an American girl's baseball team form their own professional baseball league when the men are away fighting in WWII.
In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who for decades has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter.
A sports agent suddenly discovers his scruples and promptly loses his job. But with the help of one loyal colleague and one outrageous client, he learns that loving well is the best revenge.

p.t: The Mummy: Tomb Of The Dragon Emperor
p.d: In the Far East, Alex O'Connell, the son of famed mummy fighters Rick and Evy O'Connell, unearths the mummy of the first Emperor of Qin - a shape-shifting entity cursed by a witch centuries ago.
Following the Normandy Landings, a group of US soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.
Two energy drink salesmen play the role of big brothers to fulfil a community service obligation, which quickly becomes a pint-sized hassle as they learn kids can be unpredictable.

Kirk's out to emulate his father's deeds. Spock keeps him in check as an evil Romulan creates black holes to destroy the Federation. The fate of the galaxy rests in the hands of bitter rivals born worlds apart.
Two years after M3GAN's rampage, Gemma must revive her creation to stop Emilia, a rogue military AI growing too self-aware to control.
Zora Bennett leads a team to a deadly island lab to retrieve dinosaur DNA with life-saving potential, but they uncover a shocking secret buried for decades.
The IMF is shut down when it's implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, causing Ethan Hunt and his new team to go rogue to clear their organisation's name.
Hamnet tells the powerful story of love and loss that inspired the creation of Shakespeare's timeless masterpiece, Hamlet.
Peaceful farmer Benjamin Martin is driven to lead the Colonial Militia during the American Revolution when a sadistic British officer murders his son.
A security repairman stationed on a desolate future Earth rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. Her arrival will trigger a chain of events that will leave man's fate in his hands.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Dachstein
p.d: S4 E11The team hits Dachstein, Austria where Danny and Dingo switch roles. Dingo snowboards all day, while Danny heads to a lederhosen party. Dingo pulls off a frontside 720 melon, which earns him $500 from the Gypsy List. The team hits a lake to cool off where Eero and Louie try double flips and Dingo learns to drive stick.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Italy to Switzerland
p.d: S4 E12The team finds the biggest jumps of the trip on a glacier in Italy. Eero goes big and checks off some tricks from the Gypsy List. The next day the boys kick it old school when they see how the Swiss used to live by milking goats. Afterwards, they meet up with Nicholas Muller. Danny dispenses the Gypsy List prize and says goodbye to Louie Vito and Eero Niemela.

S1 E8This episode of M80 has featured rider Colin Morrison. Travel to his private compound in CA, and Jimmy Fitzpatrick's to check his style. Also check out Beau Manley get scarred for life and Kenny Bell is Blowin up. This episodes token hottie Cynthia is smokin!

S1 E9The fuse has ben lit, and Fuel TV's first show dedicated strictly to freestyle motocross has arrived. this episode features gold metal winner, Nate Adams. See him tear up the Quarry, the Crusty Tour, and several other spots. Also, drop in with Chuck Carothers as he perfects the Carolla watch what Canada has to offer in the way of FMX and fall in love with this episode's token hottie. BOOM!

S1 E5The episode lets you follow, be and feel with Jorge Prado, Mattia Guadagnini, Andrea Adamo and Liam Everts on their MXGP journey! Enter into the world of MXGP riders and discover another side of this amazing sport of motocross.

p.t: Just Getting Started - Legends of Les Gets
p.d: S1 E4In Episode 4 of Just Getting Started, the Norco Race Division DH team revisits the iconic Les Gets trails in France. A place steeped in their history of triumphs and challenges, it inspires a mix of passion, nostalgia, and determination. Witness their journey on these legendary tracks.

p.t: Zero to 100: The Lakey Peterson Story
p.d: Filmmaker Aaron Lieber takes us around the world in this inspiring journey that charts the rise of one the most progressive women in surfing today. A true tale that will have you laughing, crying and doing push-ups by the end. With Lakey Peterson, Bethany Hamilton, Stephanie Gilmore.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - Finding Their Flow
p.d: S3 E4Donavon's concert is a huge success with guest performances by Kelly Slater, Tom Curren and many more. But after one night in Jeffreys Bay during the WCT event, the crew finds the need to escape to find less crowded surf. They take off to Durban where they hope to find better waves and fewer crowds. They are met with fun surf and a wave pool that creates the endless wave.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The South Coast
p.d: S3 E5After the first encounter at shark beach, the crew heads down the coast to some of South Africa's more famous surf spots. Pottz continues to scare the others about the sharks, but the rest of the crew still makes their way out to some amazing surf. They come across a sand bar that has formed for the first time ever at one of the more famous tourist beaches and are treated to great waves with some of the locals.
S2 E2Join Shayne McIntyre & friends as they go undercover in Russia dodging bears, tanks, and bullets in search of new waves along restricted coastlines.
S2 E3Liberia Surf adventurers, Shannon and Shayne McIntyre, set off for the remote West African coastline of Liberia to surf and lend a helping hand to efforts inside this post-war country.
S2 E1Camp Woodward is back for season two with three new kids: Cody Davis, Hunter Bagent and Larry Schmidt. Find out all about them before the head off to camp.
S2 E2Cody, Hunter and Larry arrive at camp where Larry ends up bunking with the little kids, Cody skates everywhere in one day, and Hunter ends up missing orientation all together.

S3 E3This is the first time that skateboarders ever broke into jail. Jeff King and the crew get busy at the Lincoln Heights jail. The exercise yard was never intended for this and the warden would roll over in his grave; unless he's still alive. Take a look at the life behind bars shred style.

S3 E4In this episode Jeff King and the crew are setting sail for the Cayman Islands to pillage and plunder for shreddable terrain.  The Built To Shred Crew along with Lizard King, Corey Duffel, Mike Peterson, Johnnie Layton, Chad Bartie and many other pirates are shredding everything on the island including the Black Pearl.  AAARRRRGGGHHH!!!

TAPS is checking out the Rose Island Lighthouse off of Newport, R.I. where there's some unusual activity going on. Then later the team hits the world famous Baseball Hall of Fame in Cooperstown, where supposedly some famous athletes just can't seem to move on.

Jason, Grant and the TAPS team travels to St. Louis, Missouri, to investigate a mansion that was the generational home of the Lemp family, and the site where three of its members committed suicide in the span of only two generations.

Jason, Grant and the rest of the TAPS team travels to Alton, Illinois, to investigate the possibility of paranormal activity inside the former Milton School building, where the spirits of a murdered girl and her killer are believed to reside.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist.
On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity.
The Taps team heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a hometurned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims.
The Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team.
TAPS travels to Alabama to investigate Sloss Furnaces, a 50-acre industrial plantoperating from 1882 until the 1970s.
The Ghost Hunters enlist the help of Bravo's The Real Housewives of Atlanta as they embark on this week's investigation.
The Christmas Farm Inn in Jackson, N.H., and the Old Stone Fort in Schoharie, N.Y., are probed.

The TAPS crew is summoned to the city of Alexandria, Louisiana, by residents claiming that they have a haunted hotel, tavern and restaurant that need to be investigated; the town hosts an event for the ghost hunters to submit their findings.

The crew investigates the infamous Pennhurst Asylum in Pennsylvania, which is said to have a section in which ghosts can be heard playing the piano and a tunnel system where visions of dismembered torsos and a female ghost have been seen.

St Patrick may be the most popular, yet least-known, figure in Christian history. Each year revellers hold parties and parades to celebrate his day, yet the average person likely has no idea who Patrick of Ireland truly was. St Patrick: Pilgrimage to Peace unearths the true story of this fifth-century Christian who was brought to Ireland as a slave, where he labored six long years before finally escaping. But after returning home, Patrick shocked his contemporaries by voluntarily returning to the place of his enslavement in order to bring the gospel message to the Irish people. Go beyond the legends and clichês to discover the real St Patrick, a man whose life continues to call us to the peace of Christ.

After country singer Will Brown’s wife passes, his grief stalls his career and strains his bond with his young daughter—until a talented horse trainer guides him toward strength, forgiveness, and a new start in life.

Comedy All-Stars brings together a lineup of hilarious, family-friendly comedians for a night of clean, feel-good laughter. Featuring top talent who prove you don’t need crude jokes to be funny, this series delivers quick wit, clever humour, and plenty of joy. From laugh-out-loud stand-up to relatable storytelling, Comedy All-Stars is the perfect reminder that a good laugh really is the best medicine - and it’s even better when you can share it with the whole family.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

The best-known Christian evangelist of the 20th century, Billy Graham gained world attention in 1949 with a tent revival in downtown Los Angeles that was scheduled for three weeks and lasted six. In the ensuing 55 years and more, 'Billy Graham Crusades' consistently drew audiences of thousands to arenas and stadiums throughout the world.'Classic Crusades' presents the best of the last 35 years of Billy Graham that brought the message of salvation through Jesus Christ to the world. World renowned actors, singers, athletes and ministers share the platform with Dr. Graham. Also often features the famous sounds of the Billy Graham Choir, George Beverly Shea and Cliff Barrows for an hour of blessing and inspiration to all who watch.

Maddie and Kiki bring a taste of the coast to the barn with a BBQ feast full of fresh seafood and comforting sides. They grill oysters topped with serrano ham, fill avocados with crab, fire up lobster tails with basil mayo, and serve green bean salad with creamy BBQ scalloped potatoes.

A sizzling take on barbecue traditions where spice rubs, char, and glaze create rich flavor. Each dish delivers juicy tenderness and smoky depth, creating that familiar BBQ spirit and crowd-pleasing comfort.

A girl is left scratched and shaken after being physically attacked by a malevolent spirit and a teen makes matters worse when he tries to contact the entity behind the paranormal activity in his home.

Meanwhile, a woman returns to her childhood home only to discover it so infested with spirits that her parents are forced to abandon it. These chilling stories reveal how the supernatural can invade and upend homes, leaving families powerless against the forces that refuse to rest.

When a couple move into a new home, they find that the previous owner has not moved out; a woman's stepmother refuses to rest in peace after she has died; a home that was built on the site of a terrible tragedy is haunted by its past.
Watch a child haunt an officer; meet the spirit behind a series of accidents.
Respond to a home invasion with officer Jen and chase bloody footprints from a vanishing spirit. Meet a ghostly mum and baby with military guard Dan, and see a spirit attack paramedic Ryleigh.
Examine evidence of a satanic sacrifice and pursue a bloodthirsty ghost doctor.

Cross paths with lingering souls—a nurse believes cold spots are a stuck patient's spirit, trauma binds the dead to the living, and a ghost can't exit a hospital café.
At an overnight treatment centre, youth worker Melissa has a frightening encounter during the night shift. Nurse Linda sees spirits roam her hospital.
A resident at a care facility reveals a phantom child is asking her for help. The spirit of a patient returns to get the last word in with Nurse Meg.
See what happens when two women are visited by the ghosts of hospital patients.
Witness two ghostly encounters that inspire artistic insight and prowess.

The challenge pushes the chefs' ability to work together to the limit, with one team enjoying a luxurious day out as a prize, and the other having to sift through garbage.

The chefs take part in the infamous blind taste test, but there is a shock in store for one of the winning team.

Gordon Ramsay challenges the chefs to create dishes that not only taste good, but look the part as well, with his social-media followers choosing a winner.
The final four Young Guns compete in the first ever Hell's Kitchen Beach BBQ, but whose food will the party-goers enjoy the most? At dinner service, each chef has a chance at running the pass.

The final three chefs are instructed to create their own menus for the final challenge and are paired with the sous chefs to think up stunning meals. However, a night on the town with Chef Ramsay has a surprise in store.

Hell's Kitchen Young Guns Season 20 comes down to Trenton and Megan, battling for the head chef role at Gordon Ramsay Steak 2.0 in Vegas. With their brigades assembled and Ramsay's guidance, they cook their final dinner service.

The new chefs enter Hell's Kitchen and cook their signature dishes for Ramsay. It's men versus women, and the first service is a total disaster. Ramsay shuts the kitchen down and the red team lose a member.
Gordon Ramsay's culinary boot camp in the USA challenges more aspiring chefs.

Teams must cook three entrees, but only one member is allowed in the kitchen at a time for five minutes. Miscommunication wreaks havoc. Prep and dinner service are full of drama, and Ramsay closes Hell's Kitchen in a rage.

Chef Gordon Ramsay puts aside the battle of the sexes and switches the chefs to even out the teams. Hell's Kitchen breaks new ground when the teams are put to the test during a lunch service cooking for a group of highly demanding customers.

p.d: A historical documentary about what happened when the third reich fell- and how justice was sought for the horrors of the Nazi regime.
In the 17th century, as the smoke cleared from the civil war, the first celebrity criminals emerged. Mounted soldiers from the losing royalist armies turned to a life of crime, becoming 'Highwaymen'.
Charting the devastating impact pirates had during an age of colonial expansion.
Sam Willis explores urban crime, fraud and corruption in the eighteenth century and uncovers a fascinating rogues gallery of charmers, fraudsters and villains.
Athens, a small hamlet in its early days, was established on abandoned land in 3,000 BC, but it would be transformed into one of the greatest ancient cities in the 5th century B.C.
4th century B.C.: Alexander the Great sets out to transform a fishing village into the ancient world's most dazzling city; feast your eyes on a reconstruction of the city and its amazing buildings.
They fought their way through Europe, survived overwhelming odds, liberated concentration camps, and drank a victory toast at Hitler's hideout.
Revisit the rise and fall of the Inca Empire with new discoveries that challenge old myths of ruthless giants.

December 1914. After 5 months of war, both the Germans and the Allies have dug themselves in behind impenetrable lines. Faced with this siege, the soldiers will bring back into use an old weapon that they will modernize: mines, blowing up enemy fortifications from beneath...
Examine Qin Shi Huangdi, the man who united, and indeed gave China its name. His legacy includes the Great Wall and his astonishing tomb, guarded by the Terracotta Army.
Explore Clinton's transformative, controversial presidency. Learn about his upbringing and public career.
Discover the ancient Maya city of Tikal remodelled using computer graphics; inhabited for over a thousand years, this ancient city would encompass up to 12,000 structures and two million inhabitants.
Rome: the greatest city of the ancient world. We unveil the secrets of Roman architecture and the incredible talent of its builders; explore the Pantheon, Emperor Nero's palace, and the Colosseum.
Join host Matthew Burchette as he crawls through an iconic B-52 bomber, visits The Peace Garden State, and explores an active B-52 base.
Millions have flown in and out of Denver International Airport but few have seen this incredible operation from the inside out.

Realizing that he is dealing with a con-man, Mike tries to track down his latest victims to see if he can help correct any errors they have been left to deal with; Mike explains the importance of finding a certified contractor with clean background.

A single mom, who works full-time as a nurse, has had a myriad of problems with her house ever since she and her kids moved in, so her mother-in-law tracks down Mike and asks if he can help the struggling the mom, and he comes through.
Watch Mike’s ambitious two-storey reno plan sideline MJ’s more modest proposal.

Say goodbye to MJ’s hot tub dreams when cracks in the foundation surface, then see the walls take shape on the new second floor. Feel the mood dampen when MJ decides not to tarp the house before a heavy rain and ends up with wet timbers and feet.

Roll along with Mike and MJ, who enjoy some smooth sailing as the exterior envelope of the home starts to come together. Then feel the frustration as illness hits the crew, forcing MJ to make critical structural decisions without Mike’s sage advice.

A structural snag threatens to inflate the cost of Mike's open concept vision for the Suburban House. A major deck issue plagues the Country House before MJ fields another curveball from Mike that could derail their business plan.
Financial setbacks threaten to derail the reno. Tiling troubles with Lisa and door debates with Mike push MJ to make a decision that will impact the final stages of his bungalow overhaul.

Feel the heat as the end of the project draws near and the entire Holmes crew pitches in to make the final push. Cheer as MJ delivers a custom table to an unsuspecting friend and get a front-row seat at the exciting, emotional big reveal.

Picture this: Despite stall tactics, stop-work orders, and a mayoral visit, a photographer finally gets his backyard photo studio. Feel his frustration when Mike determines that the only fix for its leaky roof and water damage is a total teardown.

Beware of falling debris as Mike answers a distress call from homeowners whose sloppily constructed basement ceiling collapsed. Learn how they were taken in by a renovation con man, who dazzled them with an impressive pitch and portfolio.

p.t: Holmes 10th Anniversary Special: Behind The Overalls
p.d: Get a humorous, heartfelt look back at 10 years in the life of Canada's favourite construction pro, Mike Holmes. See how his TV career began, what a typical crew day is like, and go behind the scenes of his best on-air moments.

A simple foundation renovation turns into a damage containment project when the crew uncovers electrical problems in a 60-year-old home, where two large, custom houses were recently built on either side and water began pouring into the basement.

Holmes helps a Canadian military pilot and his wife complete their dream retirement home after a family friend said he could build the log house within their budget but leaves them high and dry with a home that isn't done and has cost them extra.

Mike steps in to help a victim of a contractor that was arrested for ripping off numerous families in the area; the crew revitalizes the kitchen of a family that was left with nothing; Mike offers advice on how to find a trustworthy contractor.

Judy and Jaden pick up a basketball dad who is supportive of all of his kids. Tina and Darnell arrest Travis, who isn't much of a conversationalist.
In Maryland, a chase erupts when a serial dangerous driver strikes again, putting an officer's life in danger. In Georgia, police hunt a bank robber.
Elizabeth Chambers investigates convicted conman Anthony Strangis. After meeting with his former wife, Elizabeth uncovers new alleged victims.
A young actress gets her big break in a hit movie. After her brutal murder, police sift through hours of surveillance to catch her killer in the act.

CSI Alina investigates a furniture store massacre from Christmas Eve 1975.
Tina Swor and partner John Dalton start a new life in Spirit Lake, Idaho. But John's erratic behaviour and love of guns plague their fresh start.
When teenager Harmahn Smith misses his curfew, his parents seek the police's help. His car and body are discovered - what happened to the 18-year-old?
O.J. Simpson steps back into the spotlight with a hidden camera prank show. As producers push for shock and spectacle, footage reveals rising tension.
O.J. Simpson performs pranks for a hidden-camera show, exposing uneasy encounters and a carefully crafted persona that begins to crack under pressure.
A professional woman vanishes in broad daylight. When her naked body is found dumped in the woods days later, detectives begin a manhunt for her killer.

Nathaniel Holmes is a high school student with a passion for playing the bagpipes. On December 19th, 2017, his mother drops him off at school and watches him walk inside. But by the time she goes to pick him up that afternoon, Nathaniel has disappeared.
In Queens, NYPD detectives find a bullet-pierced body in the trunk of a car. They end up drawn into a dark tale of brotherhood, backstabbing, and betrayal.

When Hope suddenly sustains an injury, life at the rehabilitation center must continue as normal without her being there; an artist draws inspiration from Hope for Wildlife; an owl receives a malevolent welcome back to the wildlife.

Get a first impression of Courtney, the new boarder, as Tammy and Allie grapple with managing the barn now that Megan has resigned. Tag along with Megan, who visits a friend in Alberta looking for greener pastures and a fresh start.

Brace for fallout as Tammy blows a gasket after Courtney is rude to Jamie and Alex. In Alberta, Megan isn't as lucky finding new employment as she'd hoped, and feels the stress as she finally decides to head home.

On this felonious episode of Mythbusters, we tackle two highly dangerous tales from the wrong side of the tracks.

This special episode of MythBusters is quite literally a perfect storm. That’s because Adam and Jamie are putting Tornados to the test. And what’s more, they’re not alone since joining them for this special episode are none other than The Storm Chasers - Reed Timmer and Sean Casey.

On this episode of mythbusters Adam and Jamie return to the Old Wild West for a quick draw gun-slinging story, while Grant, Tory and Jessi hop on board the Mythbus for another manic myth from the Movie Speed. Hang onto your ten-gallon hats because this show won’t go below 50!
In this episode of MythBusters, we flirt with dangerous animals, chow down on dangerous fruit , and then test how hard it really is to destroy something totally harmless.

A Mythbusters episode without controversy is about as rare as a duck in a tree. But in this episode, there's more controversy than a year's worth of Jerry Springer, as the team returns to some of the most controversial myths - the myths that generated a truck load of angry fan mail - and puts them back under the microscope.

Tuxedos at the ready as Mythbusters take on 007 in this Bond special. Our stealthy agents are on a mission to explode the myths about Bond's gadgets, getaways and guns. Licensed to thrill— you'll be shaken AND stirred.

Star Wars provides further fodder when Jamie and Adam see whether high ground really is important in a duel, and whether it's possible to dive out of the way of laser blaster bullets (well, a Stormtroopers', anyway).
It’s an episode of real genius, explosive action and dangerous driving. First Adam and Jamie take on the classic urban myth driving in the Rain.
Can cell phones cause dangerous gas station fires? Can a change in atmospheric pressure, experienced while flying have an effect on breast implants? And can CDs shatter in very high-speed drives?

Myths tested: Could using a phone in a thunderstorm result in being electrocuted? Could a bullet pass through a man's genitals, into a woman's abdomen, and make the woman pregnant? Can a boat be driven with its trailer still attached?

Mikey was challenged by his friends to eat six packs of POP Rocks Candy and Six cans of Soda. The carbon dioxide that makes the candy pop combined with the carbon dioxide in the soda to create so much pressure his stomach exploded.

Adam, Jamie and the build team investigate whether the Confederate Army had a secret deadly weapon. Could they really have built the world's first long-range missile when the steam engine was cutting edge?
In Mythsion Control, fans challenge Jamie's physics—testing whether two trucks colliding at 50 mph equals one hitting a wall at 100 mph or just 50 mph.
Jamie and Adam do battle with each other, while Kari Tory and Grant are consumed in a battle against mother nature

The magnificent jaguar is the largest cat in all of the Americas. In Brazil, it reigns over a magical land filled with natural beauty and diversity.
In the Pantanal, the wonderful ocelot appears to be making a comeback. A team of scientists try to figure out the clues to its resurgence.
The white-whiskered spider monkey is one of the most intelligent and agile creatures in the New World, and dwells happily within a protected Brazilian forest.
Finding a home in new territory is a challenge, but sometimes, animals have no choice. Using sheer numbers to impose their will, these are nature's unwanted guests.

Off the southern coast of Australia, Western grey kangaroos thrive on the predator-free Kangaroo Island, aptly named for its unique inhabitants. To the south lies Phillip Island, a sanctuary for the world's smallest penguin species. Embark on a journey to discover some of nature's most hospitable havens for animals.
Some species simply can't survive in one place. Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys, and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives for many animals.
The future of African wildlife comes down to a simple equation: the more people, the less wildlife.
Discover how lakes, rivers, and marshes are the key to thriving animal life.

As the dry season takes hold in Zambia's Luangwa Valley, lagoons will start to dry-up and verdant grasslands will gradually turn to dust. Animals must make the most of the wet season’s legacy whilst they can.

Africa’s Great Rift Valley supports an extraordinary mosaic of animals that depend on two vastly different seasons: the wet and the dry. See what animals do to survive an unforgiving dry season that’s set to last for another three months.

The team gates to a climate-controlled environment amidst a toxic wasteland, whose people are all linked to a central computer.

Due to an oversaturated bluefin tuna market, dropping fish prices are on the way to bottoming out and making the tuna worthless. The plan is to move the backlog through the market and balance supply with demand. Buyers will shut down bluefin fishing in 48 hours, forcing veterans and newcomers to push themselves to extreme measures for one more paycheck.

The bluefin market in Gloucester remains closed, but not forever. After four long days off the water, the boats get the green light to start up again, and everyone is eager to make up for lost time. But when payouts at the fishery are lower than expected, disappointment sets in across the board as the captains realize there is still a long road ahead until the market stabilizes.

With the bluefin markets reopened, it’s all hands on deck to get back in the game. As the mates in the fleet step up to prove their worth, some captains give their second-in-command free reign; others hesitate to trust their crews. As the market begins to restabilize, can captains and crews set their differences aside long enough to put meat on deck?

The captains face intense weather conditions just days after the market shut down and must decide whether it’s worth risking it all to ride out the storm or stay in and lose out on a potential paycheck. With extreme conditions and high seas beating down on the boats, and taking a toll on the captains both mentally and physically, everyone faces the ultimate choice: fight or flight?

As the competition heats up, the captains will try anything to appease the tuna gods for a little luck. Captain T.J. Ott of the Hot Tuna brings his good luck charm onboard, while Captain Tyler McLaughlin of the Pinwheel decides to share his lucky charm with the veteran fleet. Meanwhile, Captain Dave Marciano and his crew aboard the Falcon endure their longest fish fight of the season.
As the bluefin quota diminishes, one captain lands the biggest fish of the season.

The end of the season is near, and the Gloucester vets are being bested by their rivals, who have taken control of the leaderboard. As the captains fight for what could be their last bluefin, the battle between the Pinwheel and the Kraken turns into an all-out war. Will these captains be able to focus and put meat on deck, or will they finally reach their breaking point?
The fleet battles extreme weather, monster bluefin and uncertain profits as the captains fight to land their last catches — and the No. 1 spot.

Gloucester, Massachusetts is the oldest fishing port in the United States and for the last ten years a fleet of Gloucester blue fin tuna fishermen have overcome obstacles, survived danger, and embraced glory. But this season is their biggest test yet. With a world in flux, these fishermen fight the only way they know how; with grit, resilience, and determination. It's do or die for the blue fin and the fleet, this season on WICKED TUNA.

With limited days on the water, the captains are determined to start the season off strong. Making waves early on is Captain Dave Marciano aboard the Hard Merchandise, who seems to have found his mojo after a few disappointing seasons.
Reigning champion, Captain TJ Ott, wants to bring home the title again - but the other captains refuse to let him get ahead this early in the game.

With fewer days available to fish, each captain must find a strategy to maximize catches-and profits. While some rely on meticulously reviewing notes and coordinates from previous years, others simply trust their instincts and hope for the best. But when playing it smart doesn't necessarily mean playing it safe, does taking a bigger risk mean bringing home a bigger paycheck?

Captain Spurge Krasowski is a local legend in the Gloucester waters and no stranger to facing challenges in the bluefin industry. Though this year's obstacle is different than any other, Spurge still challenges the fleet to work hard, fish smart and push their limits like never before. But can this old schoolmaster inspire the captains enough to score big in a shaky season?

Competing against Gloucester's best team, resilient young newcomer Captain Jack Patrican has struggled to demonstrate that he has what it takes to keep up with the rest of the fleet. With this season's limited fishing schedule, every second counts, and Jack is more determined than ever to catch blue gold and prove that the Time Flies is a force to be reckoned with.

All eyes are on Wicked Pissah as the trio leads the fleet. Paul reveals the reason for their drive this year, but they're not the only ones willing to do whatever it takes to be on top. By limiting fishing days, the plan to stabilize the market is finally paying off, and a higher demand for bluefin increases prices on quality catches, taking the competition up a notch.
